sections.heading: 1. Get there comfortably
lines: ① Split the load: two bags or a backpack.
② On soft sand, pull the trolley behind.
③ Lift close, bend knees and hips, turn with feet.
④ Take two lighter trips, not one big one.

slides.heading: Get it checked if you notice

caption:
The beach is the easy part. It's getting the esky there that your back remembers ☀️

A full esky, umbrella, chairs and towels add up, and carrying it all on one side across a hot car park and soft sand keeps you leaning the whole walk.

A few small changes help this Boxing Day: split the load between two hands or a backpack, pull a trolley behind you on soft sand, lift the esky close with bent knees, and take two lighter trips instead of one big one.

Pain spreading down a leg, tingling, or a back that isn't settling after a few days is worth an assessment. Our chiropractors at Hybrid Physio can help. Book online via the link in bio.

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.
